Fine celestial accents: thin golden crescent moon and starlight sparkles (SVG)

grids.marketing_layout: Bento asymétrique avec 'The Tetris Grid' : 1 col mobile, 8-12 cols desktop, gaps généreux (gap-6 à gap-10)
grids.benefit_cards: Grid 3 colonnes asymétriques avec cartes à bords adoucis (rounded-2xl) et liserés dorés discrets
grids.table_of_contents: 2 colonnes inégales : grand carnet interactif dépliable à gauche (col-span-7), liste détaillée des 7 chapitres à droite (col-span-5)
grids.pricing_module: Carte centrale généreuse avec badge 'Prix accessible & conscient 8,90€', décomposition sans artifice, aucune mention d'urgence ni faux compte à rebours

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll on main marketing layout with moderate damping (1.2) for fluid, weighted momentum

interactions.animation: Kinetic text reveal: stagger children with split lines, translateY 24px -> 0px, opacity 0 -> 1, duration 0.9s easeOutCubic
Subtle 3D tilt on mouse hover, gentle floating levitation animation (y: [-6, 6, -6], duration: 5s, ease: 'easeInOut', repeat: Infinity)
Soft spring entrance with gentle background backdrop blur transition, respectful non-aggressive timing
Smooth height expansion using AnimatePresence with opacity cross-fade
Linear infinite horizontal drift at 35s speed

motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via motion hooks, falling back to static presentation without disorientation

accessibility.contrast: All text pairings verified: #23201C on #FAF7F2 (15.2:1), #5C564E on #FAF7F2 (6.1:1), #FFFFFF on #385244 (7.4:1), #1E2E25 on #EAEFEA (11.8:1). WCAG AAA compliant.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring with ring-2 ring-[#C69B56] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#FAF7F2]
accessibility.form_labels: Explicit Shadcn Label associations for Prénom, Email, RGPD Checkbox
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab order support across Pop-up modal, FAQ toggles, and payment triggers
accessibility.test_ids: Every interactive and meaningful element includes kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='capture-popup-submit', data-testid='cta-buy-main-button', data-testid='faq-accordion-item-1', data-testid='stripe-checkout-button')

instructions_to_main_agent.template_context: farm-ts (FastAPI backend + React 19 / Vite frontend in TypeScript). Tailwind v4 in frontend/src/index.css with @theme.
core_features_checklist: 1. Mandatory Capture Pop-up: Elegant, non-aggressive modal appearing on entry or on button click asking for Prénom + Email + RGPD checkbox to unlock the personalized reading. Saves lead to MongoDB via /api/leads.

2. Dynamic Personalization: When user submits the popup, store prénom in state/localStorage, greet them warmly in the Hero banner: 'Bienvenue [Prénom], voici votre chemin vers l'abondance intérieure'.
3. Premium Book Showcase: Interactive 3D cover of 'Le Guide de l'Abondance Intérieure' with golden badge, subtitle, and instant download badge.

4. Complete Sales Narrative: Sections strictly complying with the French mature 40-55 audience — Pourquoi ce guide, Les 4 piliers d'alignement, Le Sommaire des 7 chapitres, À qui ce guide s'adresse, Notre engagement éthique (aucun faux compte à rebours, prix juste et transparent).
5. Honest Pricing at 8,90€: Integrated Stripe checkout flow (or simulation if keys unconfigured) leading seamlessly to the /merci page with PDF download link and audio relaxation gift.
6. Complete French Legal Suite: /mentions-legales, /cgv, /confidentialite, /remboursement with 30-day serene guarantee.
7. Protected Admin Space (/admin): PIN or password access ('abondance2026') allowing real-time modification of Guide price, PDF download URL, contact email, and browsing/exporting captured leads.
8. All interactive controls MUST include precise data-testid attributes.

anti_patterns_avoided: NO aggressive red urgency timers or fake discount strike-throughs (e.g. 'était 197€, maintenant 8,90€')
NO fake popup social proof notifications ('Jean de Lyon vient d'acheter')
NO dark abrasive gradients or saturated tech blues/purples
NO generic centered layouts: embrace refined editorial balance with asymmetrical text & visual pairings
craft_standards: Use 2-3x generous spacing (py-24, py-32) on marketing sections
Golden accents must remain soft and delicate (#C69B56 / #D8AE68), never harsh brass
Vouvoiement chaleureux et respectueux dans toute la rédaction française
Smooth micro-interactions on every button, card hover, and accordion item
